inspections.finding: The complete initial vav has an irregular joined lower shaft and compact rounded bottom. Unlike the literal vav-sheva control, the target does not preserve two separately diagnosable added lower levels beyond the ordinary terminal. A merged single point, damaged pair or ordinary terminal remain competing partitions of the ink. Detached hiriq, sheva, patah, tsere and qamats controls do not uniquely resolve that partition. Retain without claiming point absence.

The correctly located FIRST vayehi vav has a broad shallow footer joined to its shaft. The bar-like width overlaps a possible patah and heavy terminal ink; it does not isolate a source point from the ordinary vav foot or a fused competing class. Literal detached bar/pair/stem controls and ordinary vav/supported sheva controls do not yield one unique contour. Retain occurrence1, with the corrected right-hand locator.

The correctly located SECOND vayehi vav has a broad flat-bottomed base and a narrow shoulder continuous with its shaft. The apparent word-scale gap is not a native-pixel separation. A merged bar, compressed point arrangement and heavy ordinary terminal cannot be uniquely separated. Retain occurrence2; its real left-hand location is distinct from occurrence1.

The initial vav of vayotziu has a broad continuous shallow basal mass, with shaft ink entering its top. A flat bottom is compatible with a fused bar but does not uniquely exclude terminal thickening or a coalesced competing point. The literal detached class controls, full vav-sheva and ordinary vav foot therefore do not certify a vowel. Retain; only its anchor must gain the independently approved following-yod dagesh.

The complete yod has an additional compact rounded lower-left node beside its narrower continuing right tail, below a recession in the head. The tiny surviving white window corroborates this contour but is not its sole basis. The source-detached point in BEL36 occupies the same lower-left position, the paired BEL15 pointed yod repeats the added lower breadth, and the plain second yod in that same word has only its narrower terminal tail. Original geometry certifies U+05BC; no expected wording or grammar supplies it.
